purpose: Wall-capable migration pilot for column, beam, and wall detection.
project_grouping_rule: preserve v0.1 project_group_id and split assignment

splits.release_gate: Exact and near cross-split duplicate checks, wall page re-review, and annotation QA must pass.

source_inheritance.page_scope: All 14 v0.1 pilot pages are in scope for v0.2 wall re-review. Existing column/beam annotations remain baseline references until v0.2 page QA is complete.

wall_qa.approval_gate: Every included page must have a recorded wall re-review disposition. Every wall candidate must have human QA before approved training/evaluation use.

requires: GPT-6 v0.2 wall consumer regression passing
GPT-6 v0.1 wall rejection regression passing
exact and near cross-split duplicate gates passing

notes: This dataset version does not activate wall handoff.
No v0.1 missing wall label may be treated as a valid wall negative.
Detector boxes remain source-page evidence only and are not Core Surface or engineering wall geometry.
